name: Soirée sans armure
historicalBrief: Jetstream Sam MGR conserve sa prothèse de bras et ses proportions; veste rouge sombre ajustée au bras, pantalon noir, fourreau Murasama avec attache conçue.

supportPointQA.method: Read-only alpha segmentation of lowest8percent silhouette, equal weighting of separated boot intervals; lowest sole determines floor; retain far-foot perspective height difference.

prompt: Create exactly ONE finished 2D fighting-game character sprite on a completely transparent RGBA background. One full body only, isolated, entire head/hair, hands, all equipment and both boot soles fully inside the canvas with modest clear margins. Tall portrait canvas; character occupies about 87% of height. Right-facing three-quarter side view looking at the opponent to the right, grounded neutral combat-ready stance, no action sequence, no sprite sheet, no additional views, no text, no labels, no scenery, no glow cloud, no ground shadow, no rotation. Crisp detailed hand-painted/cel-shaded 2D game art with clean readable contours, natural anatomy and coherent mechanical detail. Use the attached identity reference ONLY for the appropriate same-period character, especially face, hairstyle, age, stature and defining equipment. The attachment contains multiple poses; choose its top-left standing figure as identity reference and render just one newly drawn figure. This is a NEW ORIGINAL CQC alternative costume, not an official Konami outfit and not a recovery of a lost image. JETSTREAM SAM, Metal Gear Rising Revengeance incarnation only: adult muscular Brazilian-Japanese man with exact strong face, facial scar, dark stubble and long black hair tied back as attached first figure. Keep his canonical single mechanical RIGHT arm, with the other arm human, and preserve his powerful human proportions. Costume OC-006 Soirée sans armure: tailored DARK BURGUNDY RED dinner jacket on torso and natural-arm sleeve, black collar and black tailored trousers; right jacket sleeve is purpose-designed open below the shoulder so his unique steel/graphite segmented prosthetic right arm remains exposed, not replaced by a plain glove or Raiden body. White plain shirt at collar, no red waistcoat under a black jacket. Black dress boots adapted for stance. Keep the correct Murasama long black scabbard and red details, fixed to a credible tailored left-waist suspension strap; sword remains sheathed and nothing floats. Quiet confident right-facing ready stance, face readable. Different from the old black-jacket/red-waistcoat gala.
limits: New authored interpretation of the pre-established ORIGINAL CQC costume brief; not an official alternative costume.
Faithfulness of identity is based on physically viewed preserved CQC incarnation references; no pixel-perfect Konami model certification.
No left-facing draw, animation continuity, hitboxes or playable admission delivered by this source.
